title: Confirmation answer
description: SoT §43.2a step 2, the body an approver sends to answer a confirmation request (REQ-TRU-009): the request answered and the response. No other member is defined, and none may be added by the caller: the approver's principal, roles, channel and time come from the authenticated session and from the core's clock, never from this body (INV-12; SoT §43.2a: the approver's principal from authentication, never from text), and the tenant comes from the session. The core turns an accepted answer into a confirmation-event.v1. ACCEPT leads to a fresh Trust evaluation, not to a grant (INV-25).
